messages:
Emma: Patio hang tonight? Thinking mini pinata + pizza + mocktails on the roof patio @ 6:30pm. Company will cover pizza if people RSVP. Who's in? :pizza: :tada:
Raju: I'm in. Can bring a bluetooth speaker and a playlist. :headphones:
Maria: Count me in. Vegetarian pizza ok? Also can bring some sparkling water.
Sylvia: love this! I can bring streamers and some paper plates. 6:30 works. :sparkles:
Dan: family-friendly? wondering if i can bring my +1 (kiddo).
Oliver: Sounds great. Is there a budget cap for extras (dessert/snacks), or just keep it casual?
events-bot: New RSVP form created: https://forms.company/rsvp-patio-pinata (please fill by 3pm). :calendar:
Emma: Company will order 4 pies (two veg/one pepperoni/one hawaiian), we can add more if lots of people. If you have allergies pls say here.
Raju: +1. can we add a little challenge? pinata for small prizes. I can sort prizes -> budget ok? :trophy:
Maria: I'm gluten-free, so if anyone else is GF pls lmk so we can order GF pies.
Sylvia: +1 on prizes. I picked up some candy and mini gift cards already.
Dan: my +1 is 5yo — should be fine with pinata? :)
Oliver: I'm okay to chip in for dessert if needed. :+1:
Emma: Quick checklist:
```
- RSVP form filled
- dietary notes in thread
- volunteer for setup (6:00pm)
- bring blankets/chairs if you can
```
Sylvia: I'll setup, be there at 5:50.
Maria: RSVP done. noted GF.
Raju: RSVP done. Speaker ready.
Dan: RSVP done. bringing kiddo.
Oliver: RSVP done. can bring cookies.
Emma: Awesome! See you all tonight. If bad weather we'll move to 7th floor lounge — I’ll post an update by 5pm. :umbrella:
